feature: LLM Skeptic + Cost-Efficiency rubrics and skill
problem: No mechanism exists to challenge unnecessary LLM usage in designs or audit cost-efficiency of LLM-heavy code paths. Teams default to LLM for tasks regex/heuristics handle, with no structured review process.
proposed_solution: Create two rubrics (llm-skeptic 12 criteria, cost-efficiency 10 criteria) following existing rubric schema. Create llm-skeptic skill with Design Challenge and Rubric Audit modes. Wire both into evaluator.md and adversarial-harness SKILL.md.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: library/cursor/references/rubrics/llm-skeptic.json exists with exactly 12 criteria across 4 categories (justification, alternatives, boundaries, fallback)
AC2: library/cursor/references/rubrics/cost-efficiency.json exists with exactly 10 criteria across 4 categories (token-economy, latency, scaling, alternatives)
AC3: Both rubric JSONs follow the same schema as existing rubrics (domain, name, version, when_applicable, categories, criteria[] with id/category/criterion/how_to_test/severity/evidence_type)
AC4: library/cursor/skills/llm-skeptic/SKILL.md exists with valid frontmatter (name, description, disable-model-invocation) and documents Mode 1 (Design Challenge) and Mode 2 (Rubric Audit)
AC5: evaluator.md lists both llm-skeptic and cost-efficiency in Available Rubrics section with descriptions
AC6: adversarial-harness SKILL.md Rubrics field documentation includes llm-skeptic and cost-efficiency slugs
AC7: make validate passes (skill follows SKILLS_STANDARD)
AC8: make sync-local succeeds and .cursor/ contains all new files
edge_cases: EC1: Rubric criterion IDs are unique within each file (no duplicates)
EC2: Severity values are only high/medium/low (valid enum)
EC3: Skill SKILL.md frontmatter parses correctly (YAML between --- delimiters)
verification_method: Evaluator checks: (1) read both rubric JSONs and validate schema + counts, (2) read skill SKILL.md for frontmatter and modes, (3) grep evaluator.md for both slugs, (4) grep adversarial-harness SKILL.md for both slugs, (5) confirm make validate output, (6) confirm .cursor/ sync contains new files
